states: Conflicting duplicate IDs in each PBS snapshot, PVE file and guest-snapshot collection fail only the affected inventory
Last accepted artifact and its open evidence dialog withdraw when an in-flight read returns duplicate IDs
Independent source remains readable and counts explicitly reflect partial reads, not an empty inventory

Recovered current point shows the same opaque ID, current verification, archive path or snapshot description in its actual consuming surface
Coverage is usable after recovery; unrelated URL state survives view navigation
interactions: Desktop keyboard Enter/Escape and narrow WebKit touch exercise refresh, evidence details and source-local retry
Open an accepted point while a refresh is pending, then settle a conflicting response and verify its dialog and artifact disappear
Open the existing phone Filters disclosure to read its partial count
Inspect recovered full archive path in the actual table and current verification in the evidence dialog
Modal close returns focus to its own current point; view tabs preserve unrelated query state

limits: Synthetic HTTP through production reader, model, router and tables. No native guest/backup recovery, independent thaw, filesystem liveness, installed acceptance, publication or release proof. Identical duplicates and opaque/cross-kind/task compatibility are additionally covered by unit tests, not claimed as extra browser cases.
